narrative.overview: These notes capture /app Command and /arena Arena after the visual-unity pass. They inherit the approved Story materials and establish no new global design authority.
keyCharacteristics: Notched bone mission with separate commitments and verifier
Sans editorial, Georgia italic emphasis, mono data
Copper preview; sage authority and settled result
dos: Do retain real amounts, complete paths, state, eligibility, action handlers, and evidence provenance.
Do distinguish local status from effective authority, and demo simulation from observed account settlement.
donts: Don't promote these compositions into Story or global rules, use copper for settled success, fabricate transaction evidence, or claim full integration testing from visual review.
productTruth: Shared treasury vault → bounded mandates → delegation; branch revoke blocks descendants effectively while an independent sibling remains active.
Arena funding reserves Root available capital; commitments do not prove correctness; a trusted signer selects a submitted winner and settlement pays atomically from the shared vault.
